children: Individuals who had never been on GLP-1 medication and put on weight within the last few years saw the largest weight reduction when started on Novo Nordisk's oral Wegovy (semaglutide), according to real-world data.

An observational study of just over 3,000 patients found that those who had put on excess weight within the last five years were more likely to be "super-responders" who achieved 10% or more weight loss compared to those who had been overweight more than five years before starting treatment.

Five years before treatment, super-responders weighed 7.6% less than at the index date, compared to 0.8% less among non-responders. Also, super-responders lost 7.2% of their weight by day 60 and 11.4% by day 90.
The study also found that super-responders had better reduction in blood pressure compared to those who saw less weight loss.
In addition, super-responders were more likely to have higher doses of oral Wegovy earlier on in treatment than those who didn't see a decline in weight.

"In this observational study, pre-treatment weight trajectory and dosage emerged as associates of early oral semaglutide response, but the outcome-defined groups and short follow-up make these findings hypothesis-generating and warrant prospective validation," the authors wrote.
The study has yet to be peer-reviewed.

title: Novo's oral Wegovy benefits those with recent weight gain the most: study
